_comment: Pressure (prompt 08 §3): moves that damage alone cannot answer, applied on top of a guardian's brain by ai/pressure.py. Every move is a real query on the guardian's own book (sql, with {foe_id}); its numbers live in data/foe_spells.csv. big_turn: when the guardian's HP share drops below trigger_hp it spends a turn reading its big spell's power (the telegraph: the player can read it in the foe's book), then casts it next turn; repeat_every rounds later it may do it again (0: once). aegis: below trigger_hp it raises its Aegis (every spell bounces off for the spell's power in rounds; a cleansing item strips it); while it stands the guardian casts during_sql each turn it has during_mp MP (with press_after, for the rest of the fight too). docs/EXPLORATION.md.

slime.telegraph_sql: SELECT power, mp_cost FROM foe_spells WHERE name = 'Gelatinous Avalanche'
slime.strike_sql: SELECT name FROM foe_spells WHERE foe_id = {foe_id} AND name = 'Gelatinous Avalanche'

knight.sql: SELECT name FROM foe_spells WHERE foe_id = {foe_id} AND kind = 'aegis'
knight.during_sql: SELECT name FROM foe_spells WHERE foe_id = {foe_id} AND kind = 'attack' AND power > 30
